sources.configuration: Constructor default cast_x_before_out_mul=False; FP32 normalization and weight multiply then one output cast. No residual.
NeoX width128 theta10000, FP32 inverse frequencies/position outer product/trig; CPU cache cast to activation dtype. _force_native=False avoids upstream CUDA migration branch.
cos/sin cast to activation dtype; separate products and add/sub materializations, including BF16 rounds.

scope: Source-native/sequential CPU numerical contract only. Five output-tiled CPU MMs implement the same stacked five-layer K/V projection without a full duplicate stacked weight allocation.
validation: Exact rtol=0/atol=0 FP32/BF16 stage-oracle tests execute only hash-verified arithmetic method ASTs. FP64 comparisons are descriptive error reports only. Deliberately missing normalization and missing rotation must fail the exact source oracle.
limits: Fused GPU/Triton context-KV keeps K normalization FP32 through rotation before final store; that is a different BF16 materialization path and is not claimed equal.
No CUDA/NPU equivalence, native lifecycle/authentication, cross-publication replay ledger, native cache scatter, useful overlap, trained proposal quality or performance claim.
Private publication one-shot selection is single-request and serialized by its caller. Model weights are supplied as caller-owned CPU tensors; no loader or model-data download exists.
